title: Machining Source Pipeline
description: PDF extraction pipeline for machining knowledge sources. Extracts procedures, tips, and cutting data from hyperMILL manuals, InventorCAM training courses, and manufacturer catalogs. Wires extracted knowledge to tribal knowledge system and knowledge graph.

units.title: PDF Discovery Pipeline
units.description: Run PDF discovery on Resources folder to catalog available PDFs by category (hypermill_doc, training, reference, manufacturer_catalog).
acceptance: Discovery results saved to extraction state

units.title: Batch PDF Extraction Script
units.description: Create batch extraction script with cutting param patterns (speed, feed, depth) and procedure extraction.

units.title: Training Procedure Extractor
units.description: Specialized extractor for CAM training PDFs focusing on procedural workflows, setup steps, and tips.
acceptance: Identifies CAM system (hypermill, inventorcam, solidcam, etc.)

units.title: Catalog Extraction Script
units.description: Manufacturer catalog extractor for cutting data tables (Sandvik, Korloy, etc.).
units.notes: Visual PDF tables don't extract well to text. Focus shifted to procedural knowledge which extracts cleanly.

units.title: Extraction Wiring Engine
units.description: Engine to wire extracted knowledge to PRISM systems (tribal knowledge, knowledge graph, search).
acceptance: Wires to tribal knowledge via tribal_capture
Wires to knowledge graph via kg_populate
3 new dispatcher actions: extracted_wire_all, extracted_search, extracted_stats
